missing.why: Light attacks grant Armor via passive, not a base stat; Rule-correct out. Including it needs a Rule change.
Common wrong answer (it shreds armor). Rule-correct out.
Armor penetration items (LDR, Serylda's, Last Whisper) get confused with Armor. Rule-correct out.

disputable.why: Armored Advance is a tier-3 upgrade of Plated Steelcaps from the boots upgrade system, not a normal purchase; players may argue it isn't a shop item.
Bandlepipes is an Arena-origin item; many players think it's Arena-only.
Steel Sigil is a new component; veterans may not know it exists.
Players think of Zhonya's as an AP item; it has 50 Armor so membership is correct, but expect surprise.
Guardian Angel's stats changed several times; it currently has Armor and is correctly in.
Shattered Armguard is the transformed Seeker's Armguard (bought directly only after you have broken one); some players will say it is not a real shop item. It has 25 Armor in its stats, so it is in.

wording.why: 'Gives Armor' could include passives (Terminus light attacks, Hullbreaker minions) or be confused with armor penetration. The Rule says stats only.
wording.suggestion: Name an item with Armor in its stats

fun.why: Easy entry points (Thornmail, Tabis, Cloth Armor, Randuin's), but 26 answers across tanks, AD fighters (Death's Dance, GA), mages (Zhonya's, Seeker's, Shattered Armguard) and supports make a full set hard.

item:1029.why: The basic armor component; reflex answer.

item:1120.why: New starter; few remember its armor.

item:2421.why: What Seeker's Armguard becomes after its stasis is used; few think of it as its own item.

item:3026.why: Known, but not thought of for Armor.

item:3047.why: Tabis are the armor boots; very common.

item:3075.why: The archetypal armor item; most players' first answer.

item:3157.why: Known but thought of as AP.

tooClever.why: Glacial Buckler is the half-forgotten component players reach for to look clever.

gemCandidates.why: Maintainer pick: the broken Seeker's Armguard everyone has seen in their inventory but never names; a satisfying "oh, that counts!" on reveal.
Everyone knows Zhonya's as an AP item; the Armor is an "oh, of course" once revealed.
Iconic item whose current Armor stat most forget.
